title: A Karen Cut Us In Line At The Ice Cream Shop 🍦
music_credit: Lurking Behind - The Fly Guy Five (royalty free)
lines: A Karen cut in front of my baby sister at the ice cream shop.
Move. Babies don't even eat ice cream.
My sister looked up at her and said, "Goo goo gaga."
Then Karen ordered twelve samples. She tried every single one. Then she asked for twelve more.
When my sister finally got her cone, Karen bumped the stroller. The scoop landed right on the floor.
My sister didn't cry. She blew a raspberry so hard, the sprinkles flew into Karen's hair.
Mom didn't even look up from her phone.
So Karen pulled out her phone and went live.
This shop lets children eat ice cream! I want the owner. Now!
Then Mom put her phone down, tied on a pink apron that said owner, and walked behind the counter.
Hi. I'm the owner. You're banned.
Karen dropped her phone right into the sprinkles.
The next day, there was a new flavor on the menu.
